districts_collection.description: Central SaaS grouping entity containing multiple schools (e.g., 'Springfield Unified District'). Managed exclusively by Super Admins.

fields.name: STRING (e.g., 'Springfield Unified School District')
fields.schools: ARRAY of STRING (IDs of schools linked to this district)
fields.admins: ARRAY of STRING (UIDs of users authorized as district-level administrators)

licenses_collection.description: SaaS service contracts regulating school allotments, active plan tiers, device limits, and expiration windows. Managed by Super Admins.

schools_collection.description: Multi-tenant record containing global metadata and setting parameters for a specific school. Inherits from districts and licenses.

fields.name: STRING (e.g., 'Highland Prep Academy')
fields.admins: ARRAY of STRING (UIDs of school-level administrators)

members_collection.description: Human profiles enrolled in the school. A single member document can bind multiple active physical devices.

fields.id: STRING (Unique identifier, typically Firebase Auth UID)
fields.name: STRING (e.g., 'Dr. Charles Vance')
fields.expiresAt: TIMESTAMP (Required for students only. Matches graduation date to trigger background zero-cost Firestore TTL deletion. Set to NULL/never for Teachers.)

invitations_collection.description: Admin-generated temporary 6-digit invitation codes allowing users to securely self-enroll their accounts.

fields.expiresAt: TIMESTAMP (Time when code invalidates, e.g., 24 hours from creation)
fields.maxUses: NUMBER (Maximum total times the code can be consumed)
fields.usedCount: NUMBER (Active count of users who enrolled with this token)
fields.createdBy: STRING (UID of the admin who generated the code)

devices_collection.description: Active hardware nodes (watches, mobile companion PWAs, classroom TVs) connected to the system. Binds back to a human Member ID.

fields.fcmPushToken: STRING (Firebase Cloud Messaging registration ID for cloud notification routing)

system_status_collection.description: Real-time state of the school's emergency broadcast alert system. Watched continuously by all active client devices.

fields.message: STRING (Detailed broadcast instruction, e.g., 'Secure classroom. Do not issue hallway passes.')
